blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Finishing the Cebu City Medical Center’s final phase now depends on repairs its own contractor did not cause and cannot unilaterally fix. The corrective work will cost the city money, the firm said Tuesday, but nobody in the room could yet put a number on it. Dakay Construction and Development Corp., which took over Phase 5 after the city terminated a previous contractor, told councilors during a Sept. 29 executive session that its contract binds it only to Phase 5’s own scope of work.
